thread:
Priya Kapoor: Midday check — quick slate on roadmap items before EOD. Drop what you did / blockers / today. Tag owners for any PRs or rollouts.

Alex Chen: Did: landed the newest spec update for streaming fallback (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821). Needs: 1 reviewer to sanity-check the edge-case for truncated tokens. Blockers: none. Today: will open follow-up that wires the config flag into the console. @Priya assigning review to you if you have a sec. :slightly_smiling_face:

Jamal Ortiz: Did: ran full perf suite on dedicated pool with the new batching tweaks. Observed intermittent failing tests in infra-ci on kv-cache eviction. Logs below: 
```
ERROR: kv_cache_eviction_test - timeout after 300s
Trace: AssertionError: expected cache_size <= 2MB but got 2.7MB
```
Blocker: can't repro locally yet, looks like test depends on a timing window. Today: will instrument the eviction bench and push a debug build — need someone to kick off a dedicated smoke run when it's ready.

Emily Zhao: Did: prepped canary config for the routing change and updated rollout doc in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/…/routing-rollout. Blockers: waiting on Jamal's debug build to ensure cache won't regress under the routing change. Today: will trigger the canary once Jamal posts the build, and monitor token-latency. I can also rerun the infra pipeline if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for routing-change-canary (job id: canary-2026-06-07-14-08). Streaming logs: https://ci.redwood/streams/canary-2026-06-07-14-08

ProductOps: Quick prioritization question — for the upcoming minor release do we prioritize cache invalidation fixes (customer-visible mem growth) or routing QoS improvement (reduces p95 for request hedging)? Both are small slices but only one can be aimed for the release.

Priya Kapoor: Decision: routing QoS gets the release cut — it's the launch blocker for the partner pilot. Cache invalidation moves to the next sprint but we add a regression alert in Redwood Console. @Alex please own routing QA; @Jamal please prioritize the eviction instrumentation so Emily can canary safely.

Alex Chen: Got it — will focus QA on routing p95 and the hedging toggles. I'll ping the SDK team for a quick compatibility check. :thumbsup:

Jamal Ortiz: I'll push the debug build by 16:00 PT and tag @Emily. If someone from eng-infra (cc @Priya) can kick the dedicated smoke run after that, we should have a green/failed signal within 20m.

Emily Zhao: I'll watch for the tag and kick the canary. Also added a quick dashboard widget for cache growth so we can see any regression during the rollout.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks team — summary: routing prioritized for release, Alex = QA lead, Jamal = eviction instrumentation, Emily = canary/operator. If anything urgent pops up ping #eng-oncall. Otherwise small async check at EOD for roll status. :white_check_mark:
